title: Expansion of Interview Waiver Eligibility for Pakistani Visa Holders
summary: The U.S. Mission to Pakistan has expanded interview waiver eligibility for Pakistani citizens renewing B1/B2 tourism and business visas. Eligible applicants include those 60 and older with valid or recently expired visas.
eligibility: B1/B2 visas valid or expired within the last 48 months
application_process: submit applications through the new procedure
important_notes: some eligible visa holders may still be required to appear at the U.S. Embassy or U.S. Consulate General for interviews
applicants can visit the website to determine eligibility for an interview waiver

title: Expansion of Interview Waiver Eligibility for Visa Applicants from Pakistan
summary: The United States Mission to Pakistan has expanded interview waiver eligibility for certain applicants of F, J, H, and L visas. Pakistani citizens who previously held U.S. visas are eligible to use this program.
eligibility: Pakistani citizens who previously held U.S. visas
application_process: Applicants may visit our website to determine if they are eligible for an interview waiver
important_notes: Some eligible visa holders may still be required to appear at the U.S. Embassy or U.S. Consulate General for interviews after submitting their applications

title: Expansion of Interview Waiver Eligibility for U.S. Visa Holders from Pakistan
summary: The United States Mission in Pakistan has expanded interview waiver eligibility for Pakistani citizens renewing B1/B2 tourist and business visas. Eligible applicants can renew their visas without an interview if they are 45 years or older and their previous visa is valid or has expired within the last 48 months.
eligibility: B1/B2 visa valid or expired within the last 48 months
important_notes: Some eligible visa holders may still be required to appear for an interview
Applicants can check their eligibility for an interview waiver on the U.S. Embassy's website

title: Form DS-5535 Submission Form
summary: The Form DS-5535 is for supplemental questions for visa applicants. It should only be completed if a visa officer has requested it.
application_process: Download and complete the DS-5535 form
important_notes: Only complete Form DS-5535 if a visa officer has requested it
Submit the form as soon as possible to avoid delays in visa processing

title: Fiancé(e) Visa
summary: The K-1 nonimmigrant visa is for the foreign-citizen fiancé(e) of a U.S. citizen, allowing them to travel to the United States and marry within 90 days of arrival.
eligibility: Be a foreign-citizen fiancé(e) of a U.S. citizen
important_notes: Administrative processing may be required, which can take additional time
Applicants are advised of this requirement when they apply

title: Returning Resident Visa
summary: A permanent resident who has remained outside the United States for longer than one year requires a new immigrant visa to enter the United States and resume permanent residence.
eligibility: Evidence of continuing, unbroken ties to the United States
Evidence that extended stay was beyond control
Evidence of intent to always return to the United States
required_documents: Permanent Resident Card (Form I-551 or green card)
Documentation of exact date of last departure from the United States
Proof of ties to the United States and intention to return
Proof that protracted stay outside of the United States was for reasons beyond control
mandatory_prerequisites: Online appointment through Global Support Services (GSS) website
application_process: Schedule an online appointment through Global Support Services (GSS) website
Attend an interview with a Consular Officer
processing_time: varies depending on the particular circumstances of the case
important_notes: Re-entry permits can only be applied for when the individual is physically present in the United States
Approval of returning resident status does not guarantee the issuance of a visa

title: Diversity Visa Program
summary: The Diversity Visa program provides 55,000 immigrant visas annually to applicants from countries with low rates of immigration to the United States.
eligibility: Be from a country with low rates of immigration to the United States
application_process: Submit entry on the Electronic Diversity Visa (E-DV) website
Complete the Diversity Visa Process on usvisas.state.gov
important_notes: The lottery aims to diversify the immigrant population in the United States
Applicants are advised of administrative processing requirements when they apply

title: Reducing Visa Appointment Wait Times for Pakistani People
summary: The U.S. Mission to Pakistan is working to reduce visa appointment wait times by expediting non-immigrant visa appointments, allowing applicants to rebook appointments at different locations, and accepting new interview waiver applications.
important_notes: Applicants can check their eligibility for interview waiver applications on ustraveldocs.com/pk

title: Pause on Immigrant Visa Issuances for Pakistani Citizens
summary: The U.S. Department of State is pausing the issuance of immigrant visas to applicants from Pakistan, effective January 21, until new vetting procedures are in place.
important_notes: The pause does not apply to nonimmigrant visas, such as tourist, student, or work visas.
